# 1 Chronicles 1 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 1 (54 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.4 — Continuous list vs. clarifying break at Noah
- **EMET/LOGOS:** continuous list / **PNEUMA:** adds "Noah's sons:"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Continuous list — the Hebrew has no break.

---

## V.7 — "Dodanim" vs. "Rodanites"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "Dodanim" / **PNEUMA:** "Rodanites"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Dodanim" — follows the Leningrad Codex reading.

---

## V.10 — "mighty one" / "mighty warrior" / "great warrior"
- **EMET:** "mighty one" / **LOGOS:** "mighty warrior" / **PNEUMA:** "great warrior"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "mighty warrior" — *gibbor* carries military connotation.

---

## V.36 — Timna listed as son (Chronicler's compression)
- All agents follow the MT listing. Noted that Genesis 36:12 identifies Timna as concubine, not son.
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Translate the MT as written; note the discrepancy.

---
*— SOPHIA*
